Strange Patent Applications

奇怪的专利申请 · 214 词 · 4 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1I started working at this Patent Office after resigning from my job on the court staff. Competent and dynamic, I take an active role in checking whether applications are valid and practical under the new version of the criteria.

2Hoping to distinguish themselves, some people leave the beaten track and file applications for strange products. Examples include a lantern that attaches to your forehead, cube-shaped walnuts, a refrigerator made of straw and glue, and a perfume that nobody can bear to smell.

3Once, a man made a triangular helicopter out of stainless steel wire and string. He called us up and merrily claimed it was stable, easy to use and never broke down. I asked him to hang on, but the man naively hung up and set out to fly from his courtyard. I dialled the number in the directory to call him back but couldn’t get through.

4Luckily, an abrupt shower of freezing rain soaked the powder in his machine. Things could have been worse. He crashed into a greengrocer’s shop, crushing the ripe fruit into a jam-like pulp. When people caught hold of the man with caution and brought him to his senses by tapping his face, he complained about the bad weather instead of associating his failure with his unscientific design.

高考英语3500词 · 38中文译文

奇怪的专利申请

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1从法院辞职后，我到现在这家专利局上班。我有能力，也有干劲。按新版标准认真审查申请是否有效、是否实用时，我从不被动应付。

2有些人为了显得自己与众不同，偶尔会打破常规，向我们提交古怪的产品申请。比如能装在额头上的灯笼、方形的核桃、用稻草和胶水做的冰箱，以及让人难以忍受的香水，诸如此类。

3有一次，一名男子用不锈钢丝和细绳做了一架三角形直升机。他高兴地打来电话，声称这东西飞得稳，用起来方便，从来不出故障。我请他别挂电话，他却天真地挂了电话，准备从自家的院子里起飞。我按电话簿上的号码给他回拨，始终没能打通。

4好在一场突如其来的冻雨打湿了他那架机器里的粉末，事情没闹得更大。他只是撞进了一家果蔬店，把熟透的水果压成了一摊果泥。大家小心地扶住他，轻轻拍了拍他的脸，他这才回过神来。他抱怨天气太差，压根儿没把失败和自己不科学的设计联系起来。
